data.name: Aaida
data.gender_notes: Aaida is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿāʾida (عائدة), the feminine active participle of ʿāda 'to return', from the root ʿ-w-d. It also carries the sense 'benefit, advantage'. Aaida therefore means “Returning; visitor; benefit; advantage”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿāʾida 'returning; benefit'; from the root ʿ-w-d.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaida expresses “Guide, helper”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿāʾida (عائدة), the feminine active participle of ʿāda 'to return', from the root ʿ-w-d. It also carries the sense 'benefit, advantage'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaida total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
